summary.verdict: The implementation conforms to the Library Curation Engine contract: it consumes only quality, identity, duplicate-control evidence and policy input, emits library objects, curated bundles, versions and rejections, and preserves provenance, lineage and version metadata without taking over upstream motor responsibilities.

test_results.coverage_assessment: The declarative test specification covers happy path, sparse case, malformed input, edge cases, pass criteria and fail criteria. The reviewed code paths implement policy validation, quality eligibility checks, identity evidence checks, duplicate suppression handling, deterministic bundle construction, version record creation and structured rejection outputs for those scenarios.
test_results.notes: No standalone executable test suite is present in the implementation artifact. During this review, a no-bytecode smoke exercise successfully ran the documented happy path and verified that a missing curation policy field raises CurationInputError with code CURATION_POLICY_BLOCKED.
